_comment: Build-time pointer to the prebuilt CLI tools bundle (ffmpeg, yt-dlp, ...). Produced and published by scripts/publish-bundled-tools.sh, which builds the tools, uploads the tarball as a GitHub release asset, and rewrites version+sha256 here. scripts/ensure-bundled-tools.sh reads it to fetch the bundle into vendor/donkey-tools instead of compiling from source; packaging then bakes that directory into the app. The shipped app never reads this file — it carries the tools. An empty sha256 means nothing is published yet, so builds fall back to building from source.
